meta.title: Lakszmi Ambasada Piękna – Beauty Salon in Toruń | Price List & Booking
meta.description: Lakszmi Ambasada Piękna in Toruń: facial treatments, manicure and pedicure, brow and lash styling, permanent makeup and aesthetic medicine. See our price list and book an appointment.

hero.title: You deserve to feel beautiful
hero.lead: Professional cosmetology, beauty styling and aesthetic medicine in an intimate setting. Every treatment is tailored to your skin and your needs.

about.title: An embassy of your beauty
about.p1: Lakszmi Ambasada Piękna is run by experienced cosmetologist Anna Jankowska-Słomczewska. We combine expertise, precision and attention to detail to deliver natural, long-lasting results.
about.p2: We offer facial treatments, manicure and pedicure, brow and lash styling, permanent makeup and aesthetic medicine – always following a thorough consultation.
about.f1_text: A treatment plan tailored to your skin, lifestyle and expectations.
about.f2_text: Sterilised tools, proven products and the highest hygiene standards.
about.f3_text: We enhance your beauty rather than change it.

pricing.title: Price List
pricing.lead: Choose a category or search for a treatment. Prices are in Polish złoty (PLN).
pricing.note: This price list is for information only. The final scope and price are agreed during your consultation.
